screens.title: Runner Map
screens.description: An open route diagram makes the start, destination, and route trade-offs legible before commitment.

screens.title: Mission Brief
screens.description: A quiet placard separates target, objective sequence, and route note from traversal.

screens.title: Movement HUD
screens.description: A compact edge cue gives one obstacle, one direction, and an explicitly synthetic demo key.

limitations: Route names, distances, mission objectives, demo key mapping, and cue results are invented.
The generated plate is original architectural context art and is separate from the official EA source.
The EA product page is for the original game and lists its PC storefront date as 13 Jan 2009; the approved scope is the original 2008 game, not Catalyst.
The specimens are a local DOM/CSS wayfinding study; they do not establish exact original HUD behavior, control mappings, or an engine export.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
